title: Unit 7
source: English File 5th ed. Elementary Workbook, Unit 7 (s.47-52)

grammar.title: Past simple of be: was / were
grammar.tr: be fiilinin geçmişi was / were'dir. I / he / she / it → was, you / we / they → were. Olumsuz: wasn't / weren't. Soruda özne ile fiilin yeri değişir: Was he Dutch? Genelde yesterday, last night, in 2014 gibi geçmiş zaman ifadeleriyle kullanılır. 'Doğmak' için was / were born deriz: I was born in Scotland.

head: Olumlu / olumsuz
Soru
rows: I / he / she / it was there
I / he / she / it wasn't there
Yes, he was. / No, he wasn't.
Yes, they were. / No, they weren't.

examples: Vincent van Gogh was an artist.
The Beatles were famous in the 1960s.

grammar.title: Past simple: regular verbs
grammar.tr: Düzenli fiillerin geçmişi -ed ile yapılır ve tüm kişilerde aynıdır. Olumsuz ve soru için did / didn't + yalın fiil kullanılır (did, do'nun geçmişidir): I didn't work. Did you work? Bu zaman, geçmişte bitmiş eylemler için (bir kez ya da tekrar tekrar olmuş) kullanılır. Yazım: çoğu fiile -ed (work → worked); -e ile bitenlere -d (arrive → arrived); ünsüz + y → -ied (study → studied); tek ünlü + tek ünsüz → ünsüz ikilenir (stop → stopped). Zaman ifadeleri: yesterday, last night/week/month, two days ago.

grammar.title: Past simple: irregular verbs
grammar.tr: Bazı fiiller geçmişte düzensiz değişir: go → went, have → had. Bu düzensiz biçim yalnızca olumlu cümlede kullanılır; olumsuz ve soruda did / didn't + yalın fiil gelir: I bought a bag. I didn't buy a bag. Did you go out? (Did you went yanlış). Soru sırası: ASI (Auxiliary, Subject, Infinitive): Did you go shopping?; QuASI: Where did you go? can'in geçmişi could'dur: I couldn't see him. Could you wear jeans at school?
examples: I went to California in December.
I didn't go to New York.
We could see the whole city.
